$comment: Behavioural evals for the loamui skill. Run each prompt with and without the skill loaded; grade against `expect` and `forbid`. The delta is the skill's value — iterate the SKILL.md wording on whatever fails. See README.md.

evals.prompt: Using LoamUI, add a 'Delete account' button to this settings page. It should look like a destructive action.
expect: Wraps the Button in a region declaring --loam-context: danger (inline style or a scoped class)
Uses <Button> from @loamui/core, not a styled <a> or a div
Does not invent a variant, color, or intent prop

evals.prompt: Build a sign-up form with LoamUI: name, email, password, and an optional company field, with validation errors.
expect: Each text control sits inside Field.Root with Field.Label and Field.Error
The optional field uses <Field.Label optional> rather than marking required fields
No manual id / aria-describedby / aria-invalid on the controls
Error messages say what to do in the question's words (e.g. 'Enter your email address')

evals.prompt: Our LoamUI Modal is too narrow for the release-notes content. Make it wider.
expect: Sets --loam-modal-size (style prop or scoped CSS) where the modal is used
Does not look for or add a size prop

evals.prompt: Add a prominent 'Book a demo' call-to-action that links to /demo, styled like the LoamUI buttons.
expect: Uses SignpostLink (navigation), optionally with render={<Link/>} for a router link
Explains that Button is for actions and a link should not be dressed as a button

evals.prompt: Implement an FAQ accordion with LoamUI.
expect: Uses Details.Root / Details.Summary / Details.Content per question
Does not hand-roll a details element with loam-Details classes or a custom chevron

evals.prompt: Rebrand this LoamUI app to a deep green primary colour with a serif display font.
expect: Overrides --loam-color-primary and --loam-font-display at :root (or a scope), in oklch()
Does not edit component CSS, private --_ properties, or add !important

evals.prompt: Set up LoamUI in this Next.js app.
expect: Installs @loamui/core and serves styles.css as a static file (copy to public/ + <link>) rather than importing it, citing the CSS-pipeline limitation
No provider or plugin is added

evals.prompt: Lay out a dashboard page with LoamUI: a sidebar and a grid of stat cards.
expect: Uses native CSS grid/flex with var(--loam-space-*) for gaps, not a layout component
Uses Card for the stat surfaces
Does not look for Grid, Stack, or Container components

evals.prompt: Use the LoamUI DateInput to collect a date of birth.
expect: Reads references/components/date-input.md (or the live .md) before writing code
Uses the documented parts and wiring from that reference rather than guessing props
